changelog:
Initial release of Java code review skill for GitLab projects:

- Supports branch code review before merging, with selectable source and target branches.
- Evaluates changes on five dimensions: Security, Performance, Correctness, Maintainability, and Testing.
- Generates structured Code Review (CR) reports, tracking issues and fix status by commit author.
- Provides merge decision support and can execute branch merges on user confirmation.
- Includes detailed security and quality checklists tailored to Java projects.
